region_policy: Largest green-emission component at fitting frame 100, fixed thereafter; retain all candidates and preview. No manual annotations. Green game-clock digits include tenths; red shot-clock digits are not used. A component can contain multiple faces; physical-face identity is not assumed.
signal: RMS consecutive-frame change in positive green chroma G-max(R,B), normalized by fitting-window 90th percentile; changes identify display transitions without OCR value claims
interpretation: Integer-lag diagnostic only; an event lies between consecutive source frames. Even equal transition-frame labels allow nearly one frame of relative phase without an exposure/display model. No fractional offsets, camera blame, graph-edge replacement or timing acceptance from this signal alone. Ambiguous/weak curves and face refresh differences must remain explicit.
failure_policy: If independent clock evidence cannot resolve the 0.25-frame gate or isolate an inconsistent camera, retain inconclusive diagnostic and stop downstream continuation at existing cycle blocker. Do not open timing selection/final frames.
